# BlackHole (vendored)

`BlackHole.c` is unmodified source from [ExistentialAudio/BlackHole](https://github.com/ExistentialAudio/BlackHole) v0.7.1, licensed under GPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`).

DJI Controller builds it as the "DJI Controller" stream device. All customization happens through `Driver/StreamDriverConfig.h`, which is force-included before this file; the source itself is not edited.
